focus: 'would' /wʊd/ and contraction 'd /d/ · 'if I were' linking · weak 'if' + hypothetical rhythm · 'wouldn't' /ˈwʊdnt/ · 'd + verb linking
focus_ar: 'would' و 'd الخفيفة، ووصل 'if I were'، وإيقاع الافتراض، و 'wouldn't'، ووصل 'd بالفعل
arabic_challenge: The second conditional is imaginary, and its melody + contracted 'would' ('I'd travel') signal that. Arabic learners over-pronounce 'would' and the silent 'l', and often say 'if I was/will' instead of 'if I were / would'.

isolation.instructions: 'Would' is /wʊd/ — silent 'l', short /ʊ/ vowel (like 'good'). It is the marker of the imaginary result: 'I would travel'.
isolation.instructions_ar: 'would' تُنطق /wʊd/ — 'l' صامتة وحرف /ʊ/ قصير. علامة النتيجة المتخيّلة.

sentence_practice: She would help if she could.
daily_drills.record_this: If I had a lot of money, I would travel the world. She would help you if she could. We would love to come to your wedding.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'would'. Is the 'l' silent, with a short /ʊ/ like in 'good'?

isolation.instructions: 'Would' contracts to 'd on the pronoun: I'd /aɪd/, she'd /ʃiːd/, they'd /ðeɪd/. One syllable, then a stressed verb: 'I'd TRAVEL'.
isolation.instructions_ar: 'would' → 'd على الضمير: I'd، she'd، they'd. مقطع واحد + فعل منبور.

sentence_practice: They'd come if they had time.
daily_drills.record_this: I'd love to visit Japan one day. She'd help you if you just asked her. They'd definitely come to the party if they had more time.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'I'd love'. Is it one syllable ('I'd') + stressed verb, not 'I would love'?

isolation.instructions: The formal second conditional uses 'were' for all persons: 'if I were you'. Link it smoothly: /ɪfaɪwə/. 'Were' is weak; 'you' is stressed. This is the classic advice pattern.
isolation.instructions_ar: الشرط الثاني الرسمي يستخدم 'were' لكل الضمائر: 'if I were you'. وصلها بسلاسة، 'were' خفيفة و 'you' منبورة.

sentence_practice: If I were you, I'd wait.
If I were rich, I'd travel.
If she were here, she'd know.
daily_drills.record_this: If I were you, I'd wait a little longer. If I were rich, I'd travel everywhere. And if she were here right now, she'd know exactly what to do.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'if I were you'. Does it link smoothly, with stress landing on 'you'?

isolation.instructions: The negative 'wouldn't' is /ˈwʊdnt/ — silent 'l', and the two d/t blend. 'I wouldn't do that'. Stress the first syllable and keep it crisp.
isolation.instructions_ar: 'wouldn't' /ˈwʊdnt/ — 'l' صامتة والـ d/t بيندمجوا. النبر على المقطع الأول.

sentence_practice: I wouldn't do that if I were you.
daily_drills.record_this: I wouldn't do that if I were you. Don't worry — she wouldn't mind at all. Honestly, it wouldn't work anyway, so we shouldn't waste time.
daily_drills.self_check: Say 'wouldn't'. Is the 'l' silent and the ending crisp, distinct from 'wooden'?

isolation.instructions: Full pattern: 'If I had time, ↗ I'd learn the piano ↘'. 'If + past' clause rises to the comma; ''d + verb' result falls. Both 'if' and 'would' stay weak; the content words carry it.
isolation.instructions_ar: النمط الكامل: 'If I had time, ↗ I'd learn the piano ↘'. الشرط يرتفع والنتيجة تهبط، و 'if/would' خفاف.
practice: If I HAD time, ↗ I'd LEARN piano ↘

sentence_practice: If I had time, I'd learn the piano.
If we won the lottery, we'd travel.
If I knew the answer, I'd tell you.
daily_drills.record_this: If I had more time, I'd learn to play the piano. If we won the lottery, we'd travel around the world. And if I knew the answer, I'd tell you straight away.
daily_drills.self_check: Does the 'if' clause rise to the comma and the 'I'd' result fall, both markers weak?

challenge_sentences: If I were you, I'd wait a bit longer.
If I had more money, I'd travel more.
I wouldn't do that if I were you.
If she knew, she'd definitely tell us.
daily_drills.record_this: If I were you, I'd wait a bit longer before deciding. If I had more money, I'd travel much more. I wouldn't do that if I were you. And if she knew the truth, she'd definitely tell us.
daily_drills.self_check: Three checks: silent-l 'would', contracted 'I'd', and the rise-fall hypothetical melody.

test_yourself.instructions: Record yourself talking about dreams and imaginary situations. Then listen back and check each feature.
test_yourself.instructions_ar: سجّل نفسك وانت تتكلم عن أحلام ومواقف خيالية، وبعدين اسمع وراجع كل نقطة.
test_yourself.passage: I often dream about my perfect life. If I had all the money in the world, I wouldn't stop working — I'd start a school for children who couldn't afford one. If I were the leader of my country, I'd make education free for everyone. If I could live anywhere, I'd choose a quiet town near the sea, where I'd write books and grow my own food. I wouldn't waste my time on things that didn't matter. Of course, these are just dreams. But if I didn't dream, I wouldn't have any goals. And if you asked me what I really want, I'd say: a simple, happy life.

sounds_to_check.'would' /wʊd/ (silent l): I would start, I'd make, I'd choose, I'd write
sounds_to_check.contraction 'd: I'd start, I'd make, I'd choose, I'd say
sounds_to_check.'wouldn't': I wouldn't stop, I wouldn't waste, I wouldn't have
sounds_to_check.hypothetical melody: If I had all the money, ↗ I wouldn't stop ↘

scoring_guide.90_100: 'would'/'d natural, 'if I were' correct, clear unreal melody. Ready for week 6.
scoring_guide.70_89: Good; occasional 'if I was' or over-full 'would'.
scoring_guide.50_69: 'l' sounded in would/wouldn't, or 'will' in the if-clause. Repeat days 1-3.
scoring_guide.below_50: Redo days 1-5, contracting 'would' to 'd and keeping the melody.

for_arabic_speakers: 'would' and 'wouldn't' have a SILENT 'l' and a short /ʊ/ vowel.
Contract it: 'I'd travel', not 'I would travel', in normal speech.
The formal second conditional uses 'were' for all persons: 'if I were you'.
Second conditional = if + PAST, would + base — the past form signals 'imaginary'.
supplementary_notes.recording_requirement: Record the 'record_this' line daily; compare day 7 with day 1.
